summary: The text discusses the impact of E-rate on libraries and schools in Idaho, highlighting the financial burden of not having E-rate discounts on their internet costs. It opposes any efforts to limit or sunset E-Rate programs.

claims.argument: Without E-rate discounts, libraries will struggle to cover internet costs
claims.evidence_quote: Libraries in Idaho heavily rely on E-rate to help pay for internet access for staff and patrons. Without E-rate discounts many libraries and schools will struggle to cover internet costs and will likely have to pull monies from other meaningful programs to make up the resulting deficits.
